title: AI document processing: reading invoices, forms and files
description: How AI reads invoices, forms and reports into structured data, how to test accuracy on your own documents, and buy versus build.
summary: AI document processing reads documents such as invoices, claim forms and reports and turns them into structured data. The question that matters is not whether it reads a clean sample, but how many fields it gets exactly right on your messiest files.

example.input: A scanned supplier invoice, two pages, with a handwritten note.
example.output: Supplier, invoice number, date, line items, tax and total, each with a confidence flag and the page it came from.

howToTest: Pick 50 real documents, including your worst scans and odd layouts.
Have your team type the correct value for every field; that is the answer key.
Score each model field by field: one wrong total matters more than ten right addresses.
Compare cost per document, and count how many documents still need a person.

buyVsBuild.buy: Buy when your documents are standard types (invoices, receipts, IDs) that vendors already train on.
buyVsBuild.build: Build when your documents are specific to your business and the fields feed your own systems.

watchOuts: Accuracy on a vendor's demo set says little about your documents.
A model that writes a plausible wrong number is worse than one that leaves the field blank.
Costs rise fast on long documents; measure cost per document, not per page.
